Package edu.kit.datamanager.takita.model

Class Annotation

java.lang.Object
edu.kit.datamanager.takita.model.Annotation
public class Annotation extends Object
The Annotation class represents the model of an annotation with all its attributes.

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update(List<String> creators, String linkToResource, org.springframework.boot.configurationprocessor.json.JSONArray selectors, String motivation) throws org.springframework.boot.configurationprocessor.json.JSONException
      Updates an annotation based on the provided properties
      Parameters:
      creators - list of creators to potentially add to the annotation
      linkToResource - target source (should never change and would only change if selectors are also provided)
      selectors - list of all selectors, will replace old selectors
      motivation - will replace old motivation
      Throws:
      org.springframework.boot.configurationprocessor.json.JSONException
